text:
incident-bot: PAGED: metering-alerts@oncall - unusual drop in UI usage totals and invoice generation queue growth detected for several customers. Pager severity: P2. Link: https://internal.ops/redwood/incidents/1783456789 :rotating_light:

Maria Chen: I see the same in dashboards. Top-level numbers down ~40% vs expected for last 3 hours. Also multiple invoices stuck in `billing_queue` with status `pending_generation`.

Alex Nguyen: Oncall taking it. Jumping in — running quick checks on ingestion pipeline and cache layer.

Samir Patel: FYI: recent deploy yesterday included a Redis config tweak (maxmemory-policy changed). Could be evictions causing stale aggregates.

Leah Ortiz: Customers flagged via support: 2 paying customers noticed incorrect usage on invoices. Tentatively mark customer-impacting.

Alex Nguyen: Repro steps/logs:
```
# tail of metering-aggregator logs
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z INFO aggregated batch 20260315-09 size=820
2026-03-15T09:15:01Z WARN redis GET keys=customer:*:current_totals miss=1
2026-03-15T09:15:02Z ERROR reconciliation worker failed to mark invoice as ready: KeyError 'usage_total'
```
Potential root: Redis evictions leading aggregator to read empty/missing prefix keys, downstream jobs then queue incomplete invoices.

Samir Patel: Confirming — `INFO redis: evicted 8k keys due to maxmemory` in metrics. The policy change was intended for mem stability but looks too aggressive for prefix caches.

Priya Rao: From billing side — invoices queued at 09:10-10:30 for daily run. If generator sees missing usage_total it sets invoice to pending and retries hourly. That's why queue growth.

Ethan Brooks: Customer comms: Support has a short blurb for impacted customers. We need a formal status page entry and an email template.

Alex Nguyen: Mitigation plan (live):
- 1) Switch aggregator to read-through mode (bypass Redis cache) for critical keys — temporary and fast rollback.
- 2) Increase Redis maxmemory (if host has headroom) and revert eviction policy to volatile-lru.
- 3) Manually trigger invoice generator for pending queue after backfill.
- 4) Start reconciliation job to compute delta since 08:00 and create reconciliation notes for customers.

Maria Chen: I'm going to flip the aggregator flag now. Command:
```
kubectl -n metering set env deploy/aggregator CACHE_BYPASS=true --record
```
Applying... done. Watch metrics.

incident-bot: ACTION: env change recorded by Maria Chen at 1783456901.

Samir Patel: Increasing Redis memory is risky mid-flight. Prefer forcing read-through then rolling config in canary. I'll prepare the revert for yesterday's change.

Alex Nguyen: After CACHE_BYPASS=true we see ingestion totals backfilling ~15 minutes. UI totals trending up. Looks promising.

Priya Rao: Billing: queue size dropping from 420 -> 68. Keep me posted so I can kick manual invoice generation once stable for 30m.

Leah Ortiz: Support message we sent to affected customers (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating a metering display and invoice generation issue that may under-report usage for a subset of customers. No customer data lost; we’re reconciling and will contact affected accounts with corrected invoices. — Redwood Support"

Ethan Brooks: Draft status page update (proposed):
"Service: Usage metering and invoice generation — Degraded
Current impact: Some customers may see under-reported usage in the dashboard and delayed invoices.
Start time: 2026-03-15 09:08 UTC
Next update: in 30 minutes
Mitigation: We’ve temporarily bypassed the cache layer and are backfilling totals. We will run an automated reconciliation and re-issue invoices where needed."

Maria Chen: Can we add estimated scope? From logs affected customers ~14 accounts showing delta > 5% and 3 accounts >20% (likely billing-impact).

Samir Patel: Agree. Include the estimate: ~0.01% of total customers but 3 mid-enterprise customers with visible invoice deltas.

Alex Nguyen: Oncall handoff note for next shift (copying in scheduled oncall):
"Handoff: mitigations applied (CACHE_BYPASS=true), ingestion backfilling. Redis config revert planned; do NOT change Redis memory without coordination. Monitor billing_queue < 50 for 30 min before trigger of manual invoice generator. Reconciliation job running (job id rj-178345)."

incident-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 30m at 1783458700.

Priya Rao: Ready to trigger manual invoice run in 35 minutes if queue stays down. Also preparing reconciliation template to append to customer emails: include original invoice id, corrected usage delta, and credit/refund instructions.

Ethan Brooks: Customer-facing email template (proposed):
"Subject: Update on billing display / invoice timing
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a brief issue that caused under-reporting of usage in the Redwood Console and a delay in generating invoices between 09:08–10:40 UTC on March 15. Our team has applied a fix and is reconciling usage. If your invoice was affected, you will receive a corrected invoice and a note explaining adjustments. 

We apologize for the inconvenience. If you'd like immediate reconciliation for this period, reply and we'll prioritize your account.

Sincerely,
The Redwood Billing Team"

Leah Ortiz: Add CSM contact and link to docs for how reconciliations work. Also include a short FAQ for common asks (credits vs corrected invoice).

Samir Patel: Reconciliation SQL snippet for ops team (run under reporting role):
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(token_count) as computed_usage
FROM metering_raw
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-15T08:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2026-03-15T11:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Then compare to `billing_totals` table to compute delta.

Alex Nguyen: I'll handoff to night oncall @Alex_Nguyen (same) at 1783460500. If anything regresses, page oncall and escalate to infra.

Ethan Brooks: Final internal comms short (for Slack announcement to Sales/CS):
"Heads-up: Short-lived metering display & invoice delay impacting ~14 customers, 3 with bill deltas. Fix applied; reconciling and reissuing as needed. Template and FAQ posted in #support-resources. Contact Priya for invoice questions"

Maria Chen: Closing notes: follow-up action items:
- Samir: revert yesterday's Redis policy and run canary (1h)
- Alex: monitor queue and ingestion for 3h, escalate if backfill stalls
- Priya: prepare customer email list and run manual invoice job once queue < 50 for 30m
- Ethan/Leah: send CS/SA note and update status page 1hr update or on resolution

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> partial (backfill in progress). next_update: 1783460500.

Alex Nguyen: Handoff complete. Leaving runbooks linked: https://internal.runbooks/metering-reconciliation.

Priya Rao: Manual invoice generation triggered at 1783459800 for remaining queue. Will post reconciliation report when done.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. Will follow up with post-incident blameless write-up and reconciliation numbers once available.

Leah Ortiz: Thx all :v:
